title: AWS Glue ETL Job Failure – Retry and Recovery
description: Handles Glue ETL job failures including memory errors, data format issues, and transient network failures.
prerequisites: Check Glue job logs in CloudWatch for specific error
steps: Review Glue job run logs in CloudWatch for error details
Check if failure is transient (S3 throttling, network) or persistent (data schema issue)
For transient failures: retry_glue_job with same parameters
For memory errors: increase worker type from G.1X to G.2X or increase number of workers
Verify S3 source data integrity before retry
Monitor retry execution in Glue console
rollback: If retry fails, mark job as skipped and alert data engineering team
escalation: After 3 retry attempts escalate to data engineering team
